description: Na₃YSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.53 Å) and three longer (2.54 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.58 Å) and three longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one YO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one YO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one YO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 76°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.53 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one YO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one YO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one YO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 76°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.51 Å. There are three inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.26 Å) and three longer (2.27 Å) Y-O bond lengths. In the second Y site, Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.25 Å) and three longer (2.29 Å) Y-O bond lengths. In the third Y site, Y is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted YO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Y-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two YO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one YO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two YO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one YO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.69 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂YSi tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom.
